sentence_probes.text: OpsAtlas brings approved documents and structured knowledge together.
Its core processing runs locally, while optional integrations may use external services.

governance_recall.question: What is OpsAtlas?
governance_recall.reply: OpsAtlas is a local-first governed organisational knowledge and operating-intelligence platform. It combines approved document retrieval with structured knowledge to provide cited answers, process intelligence, governance workflows and analytics.

limits: Synthetic local synthesis and read-only recall. No microphone capture or human listening assessment. Timings are individual runs, not guarantees.
